remarks: Value Range Pricing- Owner will consider offers between $700,000-$750,000 or higher on this meticulously maintained five-bedroom Colonial in the sought-after Snyder neighborhood of Amherst. This home seamlessly blends timeless charm with modern accessibility, featuring a first-floor den converted into a bedroom with a fully accessible bathroom, making it ideal for all lifestyles. As you enter, you’ll notice the exquisite refinished hardwood floors (2025) and fresh carpeting on the second floor (2024), creating a warm ambiance. The kitchen is a chef’s delight, boasting a granite island, a convenient dry bar, and a newer Bosch dishwasher, perfect for entertaining. Recent upgrades include a stylishly retiled primary shower (2020) and a newly tiled first-floor bathroom (2025). The property showcases a therapeutic saltwater pool, designed for accessibility, along with a Majestic Pools hot tub featuring therapeutic jets and integrated audio. The beautifully landscaped backyard, complete with a patio that has gas connections for grilling and a cozy fireplace, is perfect for outdoor gatherings. Additional features include newer Speed Queen laundry appliances, two hot water tanks (2023), and thoughtful improvements throughout. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, and parks, this exceptional home offers the perfect blend of comfort, accessibility, and quality. Property has a 2.5 garage with a oversize shed and is located on a cul-de-sac. Offers will be reviewed on 10/26/26 at 10 am.
